title: Grateful Dead Live at Columbus Veterans Hall on 1968-11-22
lineage: AUD > MR > C > C > C > CD

ai_review.summary: Muddy audience recording of a high‑energy 1968 Veterans Memorial show – Jerry on fire, Dark Star and Morning Dew shine despite poor sound.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised as a classic late‑summer ’68 set with searing Jerry Garcia guitar work, a soaring Dark Star and a powerful Morning Dew.  The source is an audience (AUD) tape that many describe as muddy and muffled, though a later remaster has cleaned it up enough to be listenable.  Overall the show’s musical excitement outweighs the technical shortcomings.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality consistently rated 4‑5 stars (high energy, standout jams) while recording quality is repeatedly called poor/muddy; weighted average yields ~4.0.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Muffled and muddy overall; lyrics and guitar still audible, occasional drop‑outs; later remaster improves warmth but the tape remains limited by era’s AUD fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical ‘68 set with a tight first half, extended jams in the middle (Dark Star) and a strong closing; transitions flow naturally despite the small venue.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as “on fire”, searing‑hot guitar throughout, especially on Morning Dew and Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass noted as sometimes muddled; overall solid but his tone is less clear due to recording issues.
band_member_comments.Keys: Organ/keyboards barely audible; Tom Constanten’s first show mentioned but not prominent in the mix.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy absent, Mickey handling all drums – “power percussion” and a driving groove noted.
